**Have you ever wondered how fair a coin toss actually is? Research has shown that both physical bias and perceptions of fairness can depend on how—and by whom—the toss is led.**

A light-hearted look at probability and statistics on [Newstalk](https://www.newstalk.com/), joining Seán Moncrieff on the [Moncrieff Show](https://www.newstalk.com/shows/moncrieff-234861) to unpack empirical coin-tossing experiments and perceived fairness.

- **Listen back to the segment: [How fair is a coin toss actually?](https://www.newstalk.com/podcasts/highlights-from-moncrieff/how-fair-is-a-coin-toss-actually)**
